scope: One hidden worker for the single explicitly admitted mid2 CPU1 coarse owner, and at most one same-root-thread Codex queue attempt. This script does not run a solver, decoder, analysis, build, Git, deletion, compression, scheduler registration, connectivity test, retry or future automatic rearm. No other existing watcher or helper is changed.
fixed_run: Tag upl_hg_mid2_CPU1_coarse_r1, new Python owner support/upl_hg_mid2_run_r1.py, 1048576 steps at dt 2^-19 s, 2 s endpoint, 1517 native frames, CPU1. The owner must already be live. Root independently reads and pins the actual new start bytes and SHA256 at launch; the watcher derives and freezes only that start's actual PID, creation epoch, executable, full argv and cwd. No future owner PID or creation is guessed or silently substituted.
new_schemas: Require upl_hg_mid2_start_r1 / upl_hg_mid2_run_r1 / upl_hg_mid2_call_r1 and exact manifest/build/program/reader-helper/root-admission/job bindings. The direct Python call uses typed_returncode_captured_immediately, not PowerShell LASTEXITCODE. A successful run must retain actual integer exit zero, exact steps/frame count and unchanged input bindings. Failure receipts may have no completed call; they remain failure notifications rather than invented completion.
immutable_evidence: Freeze the actual start and every start input, this new watcher/note, interpreter, psutil and explicit Codex executable. Full hash at launch, worker startup and terminal; polls check only size and mtime_ns against startup metadata. This is a low-I/O performance choice, not a continuous-hash or atomic-race proof. Rehash every consumed immutable and terminal raw native solver file before sealing the terminal report. Native file hashes and membership are identity checks, never decoded field, true clock or physical acceptance.
polling: Poll every 30 seconds. A stable exact final run receipt is terminal whether passed or failed. A call or process exit alone is never completion. PID reuse or command/cwd/executable change is an explicit failure; AccessDenied is unobservable, not exit. Observe a dead owner without a valid final run for over 120 seconds before notifying that failure. Binding changes generate terminal expected-versus-actual observations and a single failure notification, never a blind rerun.
queue_contract: Use exactly [codex, queue, --thread, 01a07683-bc64-7463-8db7-9ee6243967d8, --message, message]. Seal terminal plus an exclusive queue_attempt containing full evidence before that sole subprocess call. Timeout 45 seconds, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, capture return code/output. A timeout may already have delivered and is recorded uncertain; never resend. Fresh lock/status/worker log/terminal/attempt/result or temporary status blocks another launch. Only this identified worker may atomically update its status.
continuation: Ask root to inspect actual ownership, all expected and observed hashes, run/call/input/program/native identities, and current independent job state. Failed or incomplete cleanup/run evidence is reviewed offline, never blindly repeated. A successful solver run still requires a separately reviewed and authorized native owner; inspect existing/active native artifacts before one decode. Preserve all 1517 samples, 1040 IDs, 22 arrays, true dyadic clocks, ledger, original HG guards and drainage. Explicitly verify active drain receivers per history row: zero through completed step 5243, ten afterward, with 1313 post-open frames and 13130 checks. This script invents no future decoder receipt schema or decoder command.
limits: 2 s coarse alone is no independent half, theory, full consolidation, late-mode cure or formal physical acceptance. Do not infer public 3D or observer/feedback initialization acceptance from the separate GPU Release component pass. Protect formal results, raw BI4/NBI4, source/program archives and all independent active dependencies. Report quantitative results in Chinese and continue already authorized work without a new user prompt; no automatic half/formal expansion.
